propositions: AGENTS.md Module-size policy section documents 800-LOC module-size gate but omits the C901 cyclomatic-complexity ratchet, leaving implementers unaware of this structural CI gate until make lint fails

C901 ratchet is shrink-only and fails build when functions gain new complexity debt or exceed per-symbol ceilings recorded in .github/complexity-baseline.json, triggered by routine changes like adding CLI flags or guard clauses

Adding documentation for the C901 ratchet in AGENTS.md should include threshold source (pyproject.toml mccabe config), baseline file location, enforcement command (scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check), and inspection method (ruff check --select C901)

The remedy for C901 failures is behavior-preserving function extraction, never baseline bumping, and this constraint is invisible to behavioral tests so must be surfaced in pre-implementation planning
